lines: Khamosh ho kyun, daad-e-jafa kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: Why so silent, why give cruelty no applause?

lines: Bismil ho to qaatil ko dua kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: If you lie wounded, why not bless the one who struck you?

lines: Wehshat ka sabab rauzan-e-zindaan to nahin hai.
couplets.en: Surely the prison window is not what drives you wild.

lines: Mehr-o-mah-o-anjum ko bujha kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: Why not put out the sun, the moon, and the stars?

lines: Kya beet gayi ab ke, Faraz, ahl-e-chaman par?
couplets.en: What has befallen the people of the garden this time, Faraz?

lines: Yaaran-e-qafas mujh ko sada kyun nahin dete?
couplets.en: Why do my companions in the cage no longer call to me?
